input.pql: PREDICT SUM(orders.price, 0, 30, days) FOR EACH users.uid

why: The catalog-keys mode on Snowflake: keys and the link come only from the catalog, since the names alone (uid, buyer) would not infer buyer -> uid; it reads DESCRIBE TABLE, SHOW IMPORTED KEYS and SHOW TABLES, the three catalog statements. Unsampled: the old client asks SAMPLE ROW for at least 1,000 rows (max_pq_iterations 10 times a context of at least 100, RE/rfm.py:2303), and every table here is smaller, so the draw is the whole table
source: Correctness case snowflake.regression.catalog-keys using the declared fixture.
